description: NaSrBO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.65 Å. Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.86 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, three equivalent Sr, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, three equivalent Sr, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, three equivalent Sr, and one B atom.
